prompt: Stage 3-3, level 6, exactly 50 gold, 74 HP, fights alternating wins and losses. The shop shows a second copy of a 2-cost support that sits on your bench and is not on your board (2 gold), plus units you do not play. What do you buy?

options.label: Nothing: 50 gold earns the maximum 5 interest, and a pair of a unit that is not on your board changes no fight
Buy the support copy (48 gold): 2-stars start with pairs and it is only 2 gold
Buy the copy and refresh once for the third: a 2-star support would round out the board

explanation:
50 is the ceiling for interest: 5 gold a round for holding 50 or more. Drop to 48 and you earn 4 next round, so the pair costs 2 gold plus 1 gold of interest, 3 gold for a unit that is not on your board and that you would still need a third copy of. Small buys like this, made every round, are how a player who 'reached 50' shows up at 4-1 with 38.

The rule for sitting at 50: buy only what goes on the board this round and changes a fight, or what makes a 2-star of a unit already on the board. A bench pair of a support you do not field is neither. Refreshing for the third copy compounds it: 4 gold plus interest, at level 6 where that 2-cost is one of many 2-cost slots, for a 2-star you did not plan to play. Hold the 50, take the 10 gold income, and spend it at 4-1 where it buys level 7 and a rolldown.
principle: At 50, buy only what goes on the board and changes a fight. Everything else costs its price plus interest.
commonMistake: Nibbling at 50 gold with 2-gold 'cheap' pairs and never actually earning the 5 interest that reaching 50 was for.
hint: Work out what your interest is at 50 and at 48, and whether the support would even be on the board after you buy it.
